reports_objectives_help: Give a group or a monitor its own availability objective. It replaces the report's objective for those rows; a monitor's own objective wins over its group's.
reports_objectives_pick_required: Choose a group or a monitor.
status_incidents_preview_note: This is how visitors will see the announcement once it is posted.
status_template_completed: The maintenance is complete. All services are operating normally.
status_template_identified: We have identified the cause of the issue and are working on a fix.
status_template_in_progress: The scheduled maintenance is now in progress.
status_template_investigating: We are investigating an issue affecting this service. We will post an update as soon as we know more.
status_template_monitoring: A fix has been applied. We are monitoring the service to make sure it stays stable.
status_template_resolved: This incident has been resolved. The service is operating normally again.
status_template_scheduled: Maintenance is planned. The service may be briefly unavailable during this window.
